verdict_title: AI/ML Methods Demonstrate Statistically Significant Superiority
verdict_text: Machine learning (LightGBM/XGBoost ensemble) achieves a statistically significant 7.3% reduction in MAE over the best statistical baseline (Wilcoxon p < 0.001, 95% CI: [-0.43, -0.28]). The empirical gain comfortably exceeds the 5% practical policy threshold.
